description.value:
When you cast a force power of 1st through 6th level that deals lightning damage, you can choose to deal the maximum possible damage with it.

You can do this safely a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus (see the consular table) before needing a long rest. Every use beyond that limit burns you as well: immediately after casting, you take 2d12 true damage per level of the power, and this self-inflicted damage climbs by an additional 1d12 for each further use before you next complete a long rest.
